text:
rachel: Heads up — customer on Dedicated asked for a stable identifier in audit NDJSON so legal can tie policy edits across exports. Right now we only include `actor.name`.

tonY: Do they want raw IDs or something pseudonymous? Raw IDs are PII in some tenants.

rachel: They asked for something that can be matched across downloads but not reveal internal ids.

iman: Proposal: add `actor_hash_id` computed as HMAC-SHA256(tenant_secret, actor_id || epoch). We store tenant_secret in KMS per-tenant and rotate. Field also include `actor_kind` (user/service/external).

linda: HMAC gives us ability to rotate keys and break linkability if required. We should include `actor_hash_epoch` so we can rotate cleanly.

tonY: Implementation detail: do we generate hash at export time (cpu cost) or precompute on change events? Precompute on actor create/update would save CPU for large exports. But then rotation needs reprocessing.

iman: Precompute with current epoch and also store a small cache for recent rotations. For rotation we can schedule rehash jobs or accept that old exports keep old epoch.

security-bot: Quick security notes: per-tenant KMS keys + HMAC is preferred over plain sha256 without a secret. Avoid using deterministic salts like tenant_id only. Document key rotation policy and retention. Ensure pseudonyms are redacted in public logs.

linda: UX: Console -> Compliance settings -> Export behavior -> [ ] Include actor_hash_id (tooltip: stable, non-PII hashed id for legal/e-discovery). Default OFF for trial, ON for enterprise. Toggle change must itself be auditable.

tonY: Telemetry we want: `export.actor_hash_enabled{tenant}`, `export.hash_method`, `export.size_bytes`, `export.prepare_ms`, `export.hashing_ms`, `export.mode`. Also emit a span `export.prepare` with `hash_count`.

iman: NDJSON example (non-breaking, additive):

```ndjson
{"event_id":"evt_123","timestamp":"2026-02-20T12:00:00Z","actor":{"name":"svc-bot","hash_id":"hmac-sha256:v1:abcdef...","kind":"service"},"action":"policy.update","diff":"..."}
```

iman: Backend will add field empty when disabled. Console shows toggle behind FF. Canary to 4 enterprise tenants for 72h, watch `prepare_ms` and support channel.

rachel: Performance: large tenants export tens of millions of events. Hashing at export time may add seconds — need a bench. Tony, can infra simulate 50M events with on-the-fly hashing?

tonY: I can run a perf job. If CPU is issue, we fallback to precompute path for enterprise. Need estimate of additional S3 cost from bigger payloads.

linda: Legal asked about retroactive coverage: we cannot backfill hashes for past exports unless customer re-runs export or we run a historical rehash (heavy). Document that.

iman: Authz: only tenant admins and signed legal seats can enable `actor_hash_id`. Add server-side guard.

security-bot: Also recommend storing only hash metadata in our DB, not reversing keys. Rotate KMS keys with a retention window and publish rotation notes to customers.

rachel: Action items: 1) iman: design HMAC scheme + edgecases doc (2d). 2) tony: perf run + quota impact (2d). 3) linda: console copy + FF + audit toggle (4d). 4) security-bot: formal review (48h).

iman: I'll open RFC/PR for API shape and hook up tracing.

tonY: I'll follow up with perf results and a prod canary plan.

linda: I'll draft the UI and help copy, include note about re-running exports for historical coverage.

rachel: Thanks all — adding to the release checklist and pinging product for enterprise opt-ins.
